# Truncate Sentence.

@example The first four words; everything from the fourth space on is cut.
"Meet me by the Old Mill tonight"
4
=> "Meet me by the"

@example k is the number of words, so the whole sentence is the preview.
"Bring Snacks"
2
=> "Bring Snacks"

@example One word, kept as it is.
"ZEBRA"
1
=> "ZEBRA"

# A single one-letter word.
"a"
1
=> "a"

# k = 1 keeps only the first word.
"Alpha beta Gamma"
1
=> "Alpha"

# Every word but the last: the cut is at the last space.
"one two three four"
3
=> "one two three"

# A word repeated: the cut depends on positions, not on the words.
"la la la la la"
3
=> "la la la"

# Upper-case words stay upper case.
"THE CREW SENT A PROBE"
4
=> "THE CREW SENT A"

# Capitals inside and at the start of words.
"camelCase wOrDs StaY MixeD"
2
=> "camelCase wOrDs"

# A single word of 500 letters, the longest s.
""
1
=> ""

# A first word of 260 letters, so the spaces are past position 255.
"QrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyz tail end"
2
=> "QrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyzQrstuvwxyz tail"

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them);
# seed 1 repeats the first case above, so it is skipped.
@gen 2 small
"a B a"
1
=> "a"

@gen 3 small
"XY cab a XY aB"
5
=> "XY cab a XY aB"

@gen 4 small
"cab a ab XY aB"
3
=> "cab a ab"

@gen 5 small
"B XY"
2
=> "B XY"

@gen 6 small
"aB aB a aB"
4
=> "aB aB a aB"

@gen 7 small
"cab a cab"
3
=> "cab a cab"
